steps.content: You jolt back to consciousness inside the chamber, violently coughing up a mouthful of black sludge.
Hypercube-powered mechanical arms whir to life around you, removing contamination, suppressing stress hormones, and pumping stabilizing fluids into your veins.
The LINK connection has been exceptionally deep this time. Your mind still hums with the ghost of it.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Welcome back, Chief. The results of this LINK session appear to be satisfactory on all fronts. You have successfully retrieved the Monolith, and the data concerning the metropoles and the Ash Crystals constitutes entirely new intelligence for us.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We will now begin analyzing Hilda's brain to extract the "Monolith" within. Please rest here for the moment; you may review the findings once you have recovered.
Schorl completes two final, thorough scans. Once your stability is confirmed, it drifts leisurely away.
You watch as it glides to Hilda's tank, adjusting instruments with precision. A specific frequency activates, and a concentrated point of Mania shimmers into view.
There it is: the "Monolith" Hilda protected with her dying breath. But surrounding it...
You see it again. The familiar code.
The symbols form a sequence on a code strip of Mania, encircling the Monolith like ethereal planetary rings. With a soft, rhythmic light, they pulse as if alive.
You freeze. Without conscious thought, your mind instinctively engages, beginning to decipher the code.

${PlayerName}, by the time you read this, you must have found a way to retrieve the Monolith. You may still be wrestling with the choice we faced at the end. For that, I ask your forgiveness, for my stubbornness, and for the conflict I could not resolve. I was never able to fully betray my city-state, yet neither could I remain a mere instrument, blindly following orders. When this war finally ends, the history books will be filled with the names of heroes and traitors... While those of us who hesitated, who were torn between sides, will be scorned by all. But, nevertheless— I still, shamefully, love every flawed inch of my homeland. I cling to the memory of the light it once held, and I cling to the hope... that one day, it will find its way back to that light.

Loyalty defined me. Conscience broke me. It was only when you showed up that I finally saw a path forward. You were right. What one person cannot achieve alone might just be possible with two. So I am entrusting that hope to you. A soul torn in two has no future. But at least I can be a stepping stone for yours.
And now, I find myself eagerly awaiting death. I am waiting for the moment you still my breath with your own hand. It will mean we have each, in our own way, taken one step closer to our ideals.
Just as you finish reading the message, Schorl completes the analysis of the Monolith.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The Monolith has been successfully extracted, Chief. Our operation can be considered accomplished.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Whether to proceed further and awaken her is now entirely your decision.
Your eyes are drawn to Hilda, her form still suspended within the containment tank.
[Containment Tank CG]
There is no sign of wakefulness. Her mind is sinking deeper into the boundless Mania, and with every second, it slips further away, soon to be gone completely.
You decide to...
